# Cully 0.27.0

Cully restores reliable scrolling in Warp and adds a visible conversation scrollbar plus terminal compatibility checks.

- Drag the right-hand scrollbar or click its track to navigate normal-screen history. The reserved gutter leaves agent text unobscured and follows your terminal's colors.
- Keep wheel reporting active after advisor closure, divider dragging and resize. Accept SGR and legacy mouse reports, handle modified wheel gestures, and preserve keyboard/mouse event order.
- Forward wheel gestures over the compact panel to fullscreen agents. Their private history still belongs to the agent; use `cully run codex --no-alt-screen` for Cully's draggable history scrollbar.
- Run `cully setup --terminal-only` to repair required Warp mouse/scroll preferences with a backup and verify wheel, scrollbar, divider, advisor and status rendering. Regular interactive setup includes this check. Headless setup reports live checks as untested; `--skip-terminal-test` skips the exercise.
- Inspect or restore terminal preferences with `cully terminal check|configure|test|restore`. Appearance, keymaps and unrelated preferences remain intact; SSH clients configure their terminal locally.

Restart existing Cully sessions after updating. Model/token/tool statistics require real agent signals and are not inferred from the terminal exercise.
